limitations_list: Competitor channels enter only through YouTube search (logged out, one location); channels that never surface are missing, so the beginner picture is optimistic.
Channel listings round views above 1,000 to 2-3 significant figures and give approximate upload dates.
Retention, CTR, returning viewers, RPM and revenue of other channels are private (UNAVAILABLE).
Direction labels come from title keywords; mixed titles are assigned by a fixed rule.
The velocity window is 1.56 days and includes a weekend.
Audio similarity is an engineering signal, not a legal originality test; no manual listening was possible in this research.
The quote provenance check did not search every generic line; several attributions are LOW confidence.
Vendor terms were read on 2026-10-27 and can change; Kling's live price page and per-clip credit costs could not be read.
Dominican tax treatment and channel-name trademark status need professionals.
Blind listening and viewer tests are designed but not yet run; they need real participants.
limitations:
- Competitor channels enter only through YouTube search; channels that never surface are missing, so the beginner picture is optimistic.
- Channel listings round views above 1,000 and give approximate dates; direction labels come from title keywords.
- Competitors' retention, CTR, returning viewers, RPM and revenue are private (UNAVAILABLE).
- Audio similarity is an engineering signal; manual listening was not possible here.
- Vendor terms were read on 2026-10-27; Kling's live prices and per-clip credits could not be read.
- Dominican tax treatment and trademark status need professionals.
- The blind music and viewer tests are designed (and the preview clips rendered) but not yet run.
